name: HeartStrings
source:
Being a tour manager is hard. Being a tour manager for four beautiful rockstars is even harder. Follow Violet as she signs on with the y2k indie rock sensation, The Midnights, where she discovers that there's more to each member than meets the eye.

As tensions rise with each stop on the tour, Violet's choices will be crucial in determining the success of the band— and a potential romance with the guy of your choice. 

[From [url=https://chimkin-studio.itch.io/heartstrings]itch.io[/url]]
